title: A Vector for the Echo
author: Vesper Montrose
blurb: Yara Oyelaran, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
